title: A quasi-compact scheme covered by affine principal opens from globally generated line bundles has an ample line bundle
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Suppose that for every point $x\in X$ there are an invertible [def-sc-invertible-module] $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ generated by global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] and a global section $s$ such that $x\in X_s$ and $X_s$ is affine, where $X_s$ is defined in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then $X$ has an ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module.
